column1: # Membership declarations inside the six copied trees that stay as the reference wrote
# them, one per line, with the class and the reason (PORTING.md 0.1-19's fourteenth half,
# status 3.656).  `tools/check-verbatim-declarations.py` reads this table: a candidate line
# is classified `renamed` (a row in `verbatim-substitutions.tsv` rewrote it), `forbidden-tree`
# (`test/`, which the goal text forbids modifying), `history` (a `ChangeLog*`/`NEWS*` file,
# which quotes the sentence), `negation` (the line denies the membership) or `enumerated`
# (this table) - and anything else fails.  A row here is read, so it can never go silent: the
# line it names must still carry exactly this text, and the line must still be a candidate.
# The `manual-membership` class this table carried (116 rows) was cleared by the rule's
# thirtieth half (status 4.008, 2026-10-08): the manual those sentences name now carries
# this repository's name in its own title, so the sentences were renamed too and their
# rows moved to `verbatim-substitutions.tsv` - a keep row whose line is no longer a
# candidate would fail the gate, which is why the class is gone rather than kept.
# Columns: <repo-root-relative target path>\t<line>\t<the target's line>\t<class>\t<reason>.
